title: Add the handoff write, get, and purge CLI
description: Add the root command group wtp handoff write|get|purge. Write: --message required, optional --agent, --task, and --replace; human output reports scope count plus the applicable purge command, JSON is {handoff,scopeCount}. Get: mutually exclusive --task/--all-scopes and --limit N/--all; default to newest global record; human output shows records and commands for hidden matching or other-scope records, JSON exposes handoffs,totalMatching,hasMore,otherScopesAvailable. Purge: require exactly one of --id/--global/--task/--all-scopes; allow mutually exclusive --before RFC3339 and positive --older-than using Go duration syntax, disallow age flags with --id, and return {purged:N} in JSON. Reject stray/conflicting flags with precise usage errors and preserve root --json conventions.
